# The Last Bridge

## The Storm

In the fall of 1953, prices fall and the river rises. The old bridge did not collapse, and none of the workers died. He removed his hat and waved goodbye to the crowd.

## The Climb

The engineer climbed 300 meters to the top. She was 102 years old when she told the story. The tickets cost 80 yuan and the repairs cost 500 dollars.

## The End

Then the bridge finally collapsed into the water. The soldiers ran away from the flood. Everyone cheered when the new bridge opened. Why did it take so long?
